description: Byte strings that the Studio Foundation WebGPU patch series puts into a built Godot engine. Used to detect lineage in builds we did not produce. Calibrated, not guessed -- see calibration below.

calibration.method: Extract printable runs (8-120 chars) from a release wasm built from this patch series, subtract every printable run from the official Godot 4.7.1-stable web template, then keep only strings that also appear in an added (+) line of a specific patch. A marker must be present in ours, absent from stock, and traceable to the patch that introduced it.
excluded_deliberately: RenderingDeviceDriver virtual method names such as acceleration_structure_free, raytracing_pipeline_free, surface_get_hdr_output_enabled, swap_chain_get_color_space. These are Godot 4.7.1 core API names, not ours. They are absent from the stock WEB template only because that template is GL-Compatibility and carries no RenderingDevice driver at all; any stock Vulkan desktop build contains them. Using them would false-positive on unrelated Godot builds.

markers.name: cluster-atomic-fallback-usage
markers.note: The plain-atomics replacement for subgroupBallot in the cluster builder. WebGPU has no subgroup support, so this line is the reason Forward+ can build a cluster list at all. It exists in no other Godot tree.

markers.name: cluster-atomic-fallback-z
markers.note: Second half of the same fallback, on the Z range write.

markers.name: cluster-subgroup-variant
markers.note: The appended shader variant pair that lets one binary carry both the subgroup and no-subgroup cluster builders.

markers.name: fog-nan-guard-decl
markers.note: Volumetric fog non-finite guard added when Forward+ first ran on hardware.

markers.name: fog-nan-guard-body
markers.note: The float-max comparison the guard is implemented with.

markers.name: ssr-filter-storage-format
markers.pattern: layout(rgba16f, set = 0, binding = 1) uniform restrict writeonly image2D dest;
markers.note: WGSL requires a concrete storage format on a write-only image; upstream leaves it undefined, which Tint rejects.

markers.name: storage-format-table-rgb10a2unorm
markers.note: The comma-suffixed entry from our WGSL storage-format parse table. The trailing comma is what makes it a table entry rather than a plain format name.

markers.name: storage-format-table-rg11b10ufloat
markers.note: Second entry from the same table.

markers.name: fsr-upscale-normal-mode
markers.note: Explicit FSR variant define added so the harness compiles the same variants the engine does.

markers.name: webgpu-raytracing-unsupported
markers.pattern: Ray tracing is not supported by the WebGPU driver.
markers.note: Studio Foundation's 4.7.1 interface adaptation; 4.7.1 added ray-tracing entry points the backend must answer.

markers.name: webgpu-hdr-sdr-fallback
markers.pattern: WebGPU: HDR canvas output is not available; using SDR.
markers.note: Same adaptation, on 4.7.1's new HDR surface API.

markers.name: webgpu-device-driver-rtti
markers.note: Itanium-mangled class name. Proves a Godot WebGPU RenderingDevice driver is present, which stock Godot has never shipped. Lineage runs back to dwalter/godotwebgpu.

markers.name: webgpu-shader-container-rtti
markers.note: The WGSL shader container. Present in any build of this backend family.

markers.name: webgpu-canvas-surface-error
markers.pattern: WebGPU: Failed to create canvas surface.
markers.note: Backend error string; survives into release builds.
